latestVersion.changelog:
dfw-seo-audit 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Run a full SEO audit on any website, returning a weighted 0-100 score with 50+ checks across Technical, On-Page, Schema, Social, and Compliance categories.
- Supports industry-specific compliance for mortgage, real estate, medical, and legal sites.
- Highlights quick wins, competitor gaps via side-by-side analysis, and generates AI-written SEO articles (premium).
- Offers both free and premium modes; free compliance-only scan included with no API key.
- Outputs audit results in standard, gap analysis, or JSON format for integration and transparency.
- Built for use via CLI or integration with workflows/agents; requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for premium features.
